_comment: Routes whose localized pages carry an English BODY. The shell, navigation,
titles, metadata and enum labels on these pages are correctly localized —
This is a ratchet, read by scripts/tests/route-policy.test.cjs. Every entry
is a route PREFIX. A prefix may only be removed once every route beneath it
genuinely differs from English; adding a new prefix requires editing this
file, so the backlog cannot grow silently.
Measured 2026-08-09: 402 of 428 fully-covered routes exceed 85% English
token overlap in their German body. For contrast, the hand-translated pages
measure 7-9%, so the threshold separates 'translated' from 'not translated'
with a wide margin rather than splitting hairs.
zero t() calls, so every label, empty state, heading and article paragraph
they render is English regardless of locale. 287 distinct first-party
English strings plus ~4,283 words of research prose.
